answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent claims a spot on the mesa and emits a tiny heartbeat each epoch, light as a sparrow's song. Beats press into shale layers all can audit. The beacon checks 5% of agents each round; a missed check forfeits a 200 POA deposit. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 POA an epoch, plus 50 x 200 = 10,000 POA slashed. An honest agent pays one 20 POA heartbeat and keeps full rewards.
